purpose: Fail-closed no-GT audit of whether persistent V9 current-node frontier actions produce the selected verified departure, a different verified departure, or a same-node loop merge. V1 and V1R were superseded unexecuted after independent validation reviews.

approval.scope: One immutable read-only V1R2 audit of all 30 V9 traces and snapshots in the exact finalized 90-case source; no simulation, bag read, GT/map read, training, selection, threshold tuning or source mutation.
approval.confirmation_reference: User granted standing autonomous authorization for the fixed paper scope and asked the agent to choose the best in-scope option without repeated approval prompts.

sampling.independent_analysis_unit: one V9 closed-loop case within the frozen world-by-environment-seed block design

method.identity_validation: Validate every row's case/frame/route arc, graph update, current node, target mode/path and stub index; require final current-node consistency and acyclic graph backtrack paths.
method.verified_transition: Validate every verified traversal's edge endpoints, start/end frame and route arc, inclusive frame count, then require each inter-node event to match exactly one traversal before departure-stub replay.
method.target_state_contract: Every frontier row must use TARGET and best_deterministic_rule_based_frontier. Historical observed-only eligibility is bound to the exact frozen planner and generator hashes because append-only final snapshots do not record stub creation frames.
method.persistence: Report contiguous target frames and route-arc distance only against each case's frozen waypoint lookahead and minimum graph-event travel; select no new threshold.
method.run_identity: Require exact Gate-6 create_run directory, spec/card/command/RUN_STATE/status snapshots and current host/Python environment identity.

failure_policy: Fail on source state/status/count/seal/schedule/generator drift; invalid row, stub, path, traversal or aggregate; nonstandard provenance; source write, bag/GT/map read, training, selection or C09/C10 read.
expected_evidence: 90-case sealed source manifest and 60 V9 trace/snapshot hashes
recomputed outcome and frozen-scale persistence totals

estimated_cost.compute: Read-only CPU JSON audit; zero Gazebo, ROS, GPU, training or raw bag decompression.
